audit.whatIsWrong: Four of seven chart rows contradict both the packet chart and this matchup's own prose: row 0 reads Sett while whys[0]/early/spikes[0] say Level 1 is Maokai's; row 1 reads Sett while whys[1] calls it an even stage; rows 3 and 5 read Skill while whys[3] and whys[5] both say Sett wins them.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Maokai / Skill / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Skill and the written whys already describe exactly that sequence.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 5 flipped as one group with matched full+content pairs and ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correct: Maokai's Level 1 sapling control, the 2-3 root trade, Sett's level 6 R plus loaded Haymaker, and his first bruiser item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect says Sett's abilities are never named, and the decisive Facebreaker rule is absent everywhere: it only stuns when enemies are on opposite sides of Sett.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.' Standing clear of your own minions turns his stun into a slow, which is the whole reason his all-in fails. Haymaker is 18s at rank 1 and Facebreaker 16s.
audit.corrected: Facebreaker's one-side rule and both real cooldowns written into tldr, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content prose is written in first person ('I open E', 'my W into Q') instead of the site's second-person voice.
audit.why: Every other matchup addresses the player as 'you'.
audit.corrected: whys[0] and whys[1] converted; the longer early/mid/late blocks still carry first person and are flagged in notes.

edits.before: Don’t feed grit — W-root his W, sustain up. Maokai wins the Haymaker cooldown windows.
edits.after: Don't feed Grit — your poke charges Haymaker. Root before he casts; alone, his E only slows.

edits.before: Shield + true damage. Root before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Haymaker (18s) shields and true-damages — root him before he casts it, not after.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — Shield + true damage. Root before it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sett Haymaker (18s at rank 1): shield plus true damage, fed by your poke — root before the cast. - Facebreaker (16s) only stuns with enemies both sides; alone you are slowed. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Level 1 I open E (Sapling Toss) to shove and brush-check; Sett has no ranged tool to contest the first wave so I set the lane on my terms.
edits.after: Level 1 you open E (Sapling Toss) to shove and brush-check; Sett has no ranged tool to contest the first wave, so you set the lane's terms.
